name: pi-case
description: Fusion 360 Generator Script for Pi 5 case

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); function clean(dir){if(!fs.existsSync(dir))return; fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true}).forEach(e=>{const p=path.join(dir,e.name); if(e.isDirectory())clean(p); else if(e.name.endsWith('.js'))fs.unlinkSync(p);});} clean('fusion/model'); clean('fusion/scripts');"
